implementation.invalidation: Actual Queue owner, configuration, native/private argument changes, Commands mode or failed preparation clear affected variants before mutation. Identity-preserving logical reset retains its existing contract.
implementation.resource: One Invocation and existing state banks/workspace. No restored dual model carrier, shadow buffer or global implicit cache.

review.scope: Read-only audit of root Graph bounded2 implementation; no test/build/link/native/GPU run. At root request only two private compute signature/implementation files were subsequently changed to inspect actual OperationInvocation; root owns Graph caller and build.

findings.cause: PreferCapture query Unimplemented originally skipped directly into Commands while preserving dormant executable(s)/seed. Commands may clear provider private pools; a later tuple hit could launch stale private addresses. BackendExtensionAccess::query_queue performs a fresh query and does not promise permanent availability.
findings.resolution: Root added saved.storage.reset and discard_capture_variants before this fallback, matching begin/end unsupported cleanup. Confirmed by readback only.

findings.cause: Plan step.operation may be a symbolic domain root, whereas create_invocation instantiates a concrete PreparedOperation first. Proof must inspect the actual invocation artifact rather than infer descendant implementation stability. Current four provider positives require exact shapes, so no demonstrated current Qwen false positive.
findings.resolution: Root authorized two compute files: signature now accepts OperationInvocation, reads invocation.state_->prepared and retains the existing Context/provider admission and exact inspector. Root updated Graph call to invocations[index].operation. git diff --check for these two files exited0; not compiled by reviewer.

findings.cause: Two retained binding variants are a steady-state count. Structural cudaGraphExecUpdate incompatibility can temporarily coexist with the other retained variant, old nonlaunchable seed and fresh executable.
findings.resolution: Root comment now says two retained variants and transient third executable with unknown native bytes. This does not establish a strict peak-two memory bound.

checks.result: Active artifact lives in captured_ranges only. Its slot keeps a borrowed valid key but no command owner. Ordinary rebind moves it back into the matching slot; hit moves one dormant command back to active and updates active_variant/last_used. No duplicate launchable owner found.

Every emitting command input/output participates, including TensorDesc, MemoryResourceRef, native_handle, offset and size, with exact final port count. Keys borrow views, not ReadLease/WriteLease admission. prepare_invocation_bindings and seals still run before variant selection; hit grants no readiness or permission.

Fixed two slots per immutable planned capture range. Miss prefers an unused slot; with two keys it evicts 1-last_used. Replaced key cleared before recording; new key published only after end and successful preparation completion wait. At most two retained keys/launchable artifacts in steady state; transient native fallback bound is separately described.

Explicit Commands clears active captures and all saved variants before ordinary provider encoders. Actual Queue owner replacement clears covering active/dormant/seed before hooks. invalidate_step_recording clears all covering saved state even if active artifact was previously moved dormant. Native/private configuration changes remain required to call force invalidation before mutation.

Root explicitly retained existing physical-identity-preserving reset semantics. reset/reset_configuration revoke replay and permissions, but need not destroy stable physical artifacts. Actual native/private changes must force invalidation in original payload callbacks before mutation. Do not claim reset itself clears every variant.

Every emitting step needs its exact positive private-stability capability; native_inputs and unknown step implementations reject variants. Regions inspect actual original slot; operations now inspect actual invocation prepared state. Backend must also report stable TensorView binding identity before a reusable key is remembered. GGML proof depends on the actual compiled patched outer-record pools and must not be inferred merely from borrowed views.

Changed bindings prepare the original slot before key lookup; failed hook does not commit prepared_revision. Recording/end/wait failure does not publish a new active artifact or prepared route and clears dormant variants/seeds. Failed provider recording cannot be bypassed by a surviving old variant in that range. Running/failed phase, retained result/observation and preparation-use gates block mutation/reuse until actual retirement; retired error phase remains failed.

Range counts are immutable plan-bounded. Both borrowed-key vectors reserve full port count during cold qualification before new capture device work; push after record is assertion-backed by reserve. Allocation failures propagate without committing a new route. Capture members destruct before original provider slots, workspace and Queue owners; no new key/lease ownership cycle found.

Unknown capture/private native allocation bytes remain unknown; bounded2 does not turn this into a strict device-memory quota.

timer.endpoint_scope: Consumer high-resolution host endpoints determine TPS; parent QPC brackets process/received stderr only.

limits: Three fresh timing processes per arm; descriptive median/min/max only, no significance claim.
TPS is computed per process from actual counts and full endpoints, then summarized. Never pool windows or average phase TPS.
Different natural IDs/EOS lengths mean different follow-up token work. Same prompt/quota is not a promise of identical output or quality.
Memory uses four separate monitored processes,10ms requested cadence with actual gaps/cost/nulls. Never use their timing as throughput.
Dedicated/shared peaks are separate; simultaneous total uses same-sample addition only. CPU commit/WS/GPU shared overlap, not physical allocation sums.
No exclusive GPU control, fixed clocks, killed desktop apps, page-cache clearing, warmup, profiler or synthetic acceptance.

Both Hyle modes use the current AS image/F32-score policy; both peer modes use the current AR host image with cached native libraries and GGUF320/335. BF16 weights/activation/state and arithmetic contracts still differ.
Only within-arm output/work/decisions are required to repeat. Natural output differences across modes/engines are reported, not converted into same-token speed or quality claims.
AU Hyle plain/MTP is a new four-arm window. Never reuse a deleted old Hyle-off image, pool historical V/W/AC/AD/AF timing, or treat independent memory-process timing as throughput.

ready_baseline.definition: Last process-running sample between received ready and earliest actual prefill-begin; null when none exists.

limits: All boundaries are parent receipt times from live stderr, not exact device/allocator times. Phase names are discovered from actual markers, including session prefixes.
Missing/duplicate/reversed boundaries have no derived phase values; short/full-hit phases may have zero samples. Null bytes remain null, never zero-filled.
PSAPI/PDH sampled maxima are lower bounds, not physical allocation totals. Dedicated/shared separate maxima must not be added; total uses simultaneous available counters.
Neighbor-sample phase deltas include bracket age and may include subsequent work or teardown; they do not attribute allocations or frees.
Old runs whose observer dropped session-prefixed markers cannot have timestamped phase samples reconstructed from untimestamped stderr. This adapter does not rewrite them.
Memory sampling is independent and never contributes to unmonitored timing denominators.
hyle_plain.counter_source: Windows PSAPI and PDH GPU Process Memory (WDDM); not direct DXGI allocator enumeration

full_performance.comparison_reference_note: The inherited previous_AR_work_preserved_by_arm label in the AU driver compares the immediately preceding AS window; the actual source paths are preserved in the archived driver.

limits: Three new timing processes per arm, interleaved, and four separate memory processes. All samples and ranges retained; medians are descriptive, not universal statistical speed guarantees.
Same original BF16 weights and P154 input, C1024, 64 visible outputs, greedy K1, N1/R1, prefix off, replay auto. Complete decode counts all 63 outputs after prefill through host-visible completion.
Cross-engine natural continuations diverge at output 19. Intermediate arithmetic and MTP acceptance/work differ. This is not a same-token or per-operator same-math claim.
The combined figure is 64/(prefill+decode), excluding loading. It is not multi-round, concurrent-serving or cold-start throughput.

Independent PSAPI/PDH peaks are sampled per-process counters, not exact physical GPU allocations. Dedicated/shared peaks cannot be added; total is sampled at the same instant. CPU working set/commit and shared GPU memory are not disjoint.

Against AS, dedicated GPU sampled peaks rose by 6 MiB ordinary and 16 MiB MTP. Driver-private graph bytes are unknown. Stable capture count is bounded at two, with a possible third executable transiently during structural fallback.
The 534 vector checks and 324 previous-image full payload matches are finite CUDA state regressions, not all-platform/all-artifact numerical quality coverage.
No new SDK/NVCC/shader builds and no further favorable-sample reruns. Other applicable MTP artifacts, remaining performance gaps and the broad architecture/capability goal remain incomplete.
